title: A Distinct Covering System with Minimum Modulus 7 and Minimal Least Common Multiple 10080
summary: We determine the minimum possible least common multiple of a distinct covering system whose minimum modulus is $7$. Klein previously constructed such a system with least common multiple $15120$ and conjectured that this value was minimal. We give a construction with least common multiple $10080$, and we prove that no smaller least common multiple can occur. The proof is organized as a successive filtering argument.
